inputs.text: The warning is right: parties are turning into exclusive clubs for the wealthy, and the APC’s direction ahead of the 2027 elections looks less like an accident than a deliberate narrowing of who gets to participate. When public-service parties become gatekeepers for moneyed interests, “democracy” can remain on paper while ordinary people are pushed out of the decisions that shape their future. The lack of scrutiny only helps those benefiting from the shift.
